reset_fee: no reset; 'Retry' button opens a new purchase of the same product with an automatic (unstated) discount
time_limit: unlimited on all products except IF1 (24 hours)
scaling_plan: Instant Funding accounts double in size per scale-up to $1.28M; challenge/micro products scale up to +100% of starting balance
max_risk_per_trade: losing/risking more than 50% of the starting daily drawdown in one trade idea = hard breach
inactivity_rule: Account closed if no trade within 60 days of purchase or of the last trade
notes: One-time fees, no monthly charges. KYC via SumSub: on passing a challenge (before funded account) or at first payout on Instant accounts. Copy trading allowed only from accounts you own (including your own accounts at other firms/brokers). Hedging within one account allowed; cross-account/group hedging banned. Public third-party EAs restricted; martingale/grid/HFT rules apply. On-demand payouts on most simulated funded products; One-Phase Lite min withdrawal 1.5% of starting balance. Refund policy is in a PDF linked from the trading rules page that I could not parse — left null.
